messages.text:
A quick quirk: Python’s default Windows text decoding choked on Nushell’s box drawing bytes, so I’m switching probes to raw bytes/UTF-8.

The implementation can still write UTF-8 cleanly; this is just the probing harness being overly provincial.

commands.commandLine:
"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command "@'
import subprocess, pathlib
ref=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip()
cases=[\"[1 2 3]\",\"{a: 1, b: 'x'}\",\"'{\\\"a\\\":1}' | from json\",\"[[a b]; [1 2] [3 4]] | get a\",\"[[a b]; [1 2] [3 4]] | select b\",\"'a,b\\n1,2\\n' | from csv\",\"[1 2 3] | first\",\"[1 2 3] | last\",\"[1 2 3] | reverse\",\"[3 1 2] | sort\",\"[[a b]; [1 2] [3 4]] | where a > 1\",\"[[a b]; [1 2] [3 4]] | each { |it| "'$it.a + $it.b }","'"'abc' | split chars\",\"'a,b,c' | split row ','\",\"'abc' | str substring 1..2\"]
for c in cases:
    p=subprocess.run([ref,'-c',c],capture_output=True)
    print('CASE',c)
    print('code',p.returncode)
    print('stdout',p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace').replace('\\r',''))
    print('stderr',p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')[:500].replace('\\r',''))
    print('repr',repr(p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace').replace('\\r','')))
    print('-'*40)
'@ | python -"
